query: SELECT event,properties.utm_source AS source,properties.utm_campaign AS campaign,count() AS events,uniq(distinct_id) AS ids FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-04 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-06 08:31:20') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' AND event IN ('site_page_viewed','product_tour_cta_clicked','product_tour_started','run_simulated','recovery_step_completed','demo_booking_clicked','sales_request_submitted') GROUP BY event,source,campaign ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 40
limitations: Aggregate events and anonymous IDs; not a sequential funnel or verified buyers. Only explicit test tags excluded; founder/QA traffic may remain.

supplier_control_campaign.query: SELECT event,count() AS events,uniq(distinct_id) AS ids FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-04 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-06 08:31:20') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' AND (properties.utm_campaign='supplier_control' OR properties.first_utm_campaign='supplier_control' OR properties.utm_source='x' OR properties.first_utm_source='x') GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 20
